# Security policy

## Report a vulnerability

Please do not report security vulnerabilities in public issues or discussions.
Use the repository's private GitHub reporting form from the
[Security Advisories page](https://github.com/AidanBoissonneault/BushSCAD-Language/security/advisories)
by selecting **Report a vulnerability**. The repository owner must enable
Private vulnerability reporting in the repository's Security settings before
the private reporting form is available.

If the private reporting action is unavailable, do not post vulnerability
details publicly. Contact the maintainer through the contact information on the
[ByAidan profile](https://github.com/AidanBoissonneault) and request a private
reporting route.

## Supported versions

Report vulnerabilities for the current supported BushSCAD release. The
extension supports local Windows, macOS, and Linux workspaces in VS Code 1.135
or later.
